chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Jamil ibn Salih, from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:

I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who said to his wife, "I have given the choice to you," and she chose herself before standing up. He عليه السلام said, "That is valid against him." I said, "Then is there mutʿah for her?" He عليه السلام said, "Yes." I said, "Then is there inheritance for her if the husband dies before her waiting period ends?" He عليه السلام said, "Yes, and if she dies, the husband inherits from her."

key_terms.الْخِيَارَ: the option or choice granted by the husband to his wife regarding separation
key_terms.مُتْعَةٌ: compensation or provision due to the woman in this context

ai.seo_question: If a husband gives his wife the choice and she chooses separation, does the divorce take effect and do inheritance rules still apply during the ʿiddah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on a husband granting his wife the option to separate herself, and her exercising that choice immediately. It establishes that the separation takes effect, that she is entitled to mutʿah, and that mutual inheritance remains between the spouses if death occurs before the end of the ʿiddah.
